events.name: New Orleans Saints at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott scored the only Dallas touchdown and the Cowboys stifled Drew Brees and the Saints, ending New Orleans' 10-game winning streak with a 13-10 victory Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys stifle Brees, end Saints' 10-game win streak, 13-10

headlines.description: Rookie Lamar Jackson ran for a touchdown and Baltimore's defense turned in a dominating performance, leading the Ravens to a 26-16 victory over the feeble Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens dominate Falcons 26-16 for 3rd straight win

headlines.description: Rookie Phillip Lindsay ran for a career-high 157 yards and a pair of touchdowns Sunday as the Denver Broncos adapted to a windy afternoon and got their third straight victory, 24-10 over the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lindsay leads Denver to 3rd straight win, 24-10 over Bengals

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Todd Gurley ran for 132 yards and two touchdowns to help the Los Angeles Rams overcome a sputtering start to beat the Detroit Lions 30-16 Sunday and clinch the NFC West title for a second straight season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Todd Gurley-led Rams beat Lions 30-16, clinch NFC West title

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Zane Gonzalez kicked a 44-yard field goal for Arizona with 1:41 left, Green Bay's Mason Crosby missed a 49-yard attempt as time expired and the Cardinals braved wintry conditions to hold on for a 20-17 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals stun fading Packers for 20-17 win at Lambeau

headlines.description: Jordan Phillips drew a costly penalty for taunting his former team, setting up a touchdown with nine minutes left that helped the Miami Dolphins rally past the Buffalo Bills 21-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillips penalty hurts as Bills lose to Dolphins 21-17

events.name: Chicago Bears at New York Giants

headlines.description: Aldrick Rosas kicked a 44-yard field goal in overtime and the New York Giants beat NFC North-leading Chicago 30-27 Sunday, snapping the Bears' five-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rosas' overtime FG the winner as Giants stun Bears 30-27

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw for 249 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Tampa Bay Buccaneers to a 24-17 victory over the reeling Carolina Panthers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws for 2 TDs, Buccaneers beat Panthers 24-17

headlines.description: Jalen Ramsey and the Jacksonville Jaguars delivered one of the most dominant defensive performances in franchise history, carrying the team to a 6-0 victory against Andrew Luck and the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars show up on defense, shut down Luck, Colts 6-0

headlines.description: Deshaun Watson threw a touchdown pass and the Houston Texans intercepted rookie Baker Mayfield three times, returning one for a score, to extend their franchise-record winning streak to nine games with a 29-13 victory over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans get 9th straight win, 29-13, win over Browns

events.name: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw an 11-yard touchdown pass to Corey Davis with 36 seconds left, and the Tennessee Titans rallied from a 16-point deficit and beat the New York Jets 26-22 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans shake off ugly start, rally to edge Jets 26-22

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes threw four touchdown passes Sunday to join Peyton Manning and Tom Brady as the only QBs to reach the 40 TD mark through 12 games. The Kansas City Chiefs won their first game since releasing star running back Kareem Hunt, 40-33 over the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 4 TDs to lead Chiefs past Raiders 40-33

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady passed for 311 yards and a touchdown, Bill Belichick earned his 250th victory, including playoffs, as Patriots coach and New England beat the Minnesota Vikings 24-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Belichick wins 250th with Pats in 24-10 victory over Vikes

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw three first-half touchdowns on just four completions and finished with four TD passes. Bobby Wagner capped a blowout with a 98-yard interception return touchdown, and the Seattle Seahawks won their third straight by beating the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson's big day leads Seahawks past San Francisco 43-16

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Michael Badgley kicked a 29-yard field goal on the final play to lift the Los Angeles Chargers to a 33-30 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday night.
Carson Wentz ran around and extended plays the way he did before his knee injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz tosses for 2 TDs, leads Eagles over Redskins 28-13
